The Manifold is the name given to the vast, world-spanning complex of titan machines, forges, and installations engineered by the titan-forged Keepers on Azeroth for the Pantheon of Order. It would bring order to Azeroth, and create a means by which the Pantheon could examine the Worldsoul in depth. It notably includes the Great Forges of Wills and Origination, which produced vast numbers of titan-forged workers and fueled the Acclimation to heal the ravaged world, and the Coreway, a direct channel to the heart of Azeroth, that would allow the titans to study the Worldsoul without harming it. .]] The Map Pin helps players mark specific points on their world map and share them with others through chat. It's useful for identifying quest locations, rare spawn spots, or gathering nodes. Players can click the Map Pin button on the map or control-click to set a pin anywhere on the map, which can then be shared as a clickable link in chat for easy navigation by shift-clicking it into chat. Pins can be removed by control-clicking them to keep the map clean. In addition to the placing the pin, a pin can be clicked to focus similar to clicking a quest icon to focus it. Afterward, Benatauk prepared a puzzle as he wanted to reward her with her own Thinking Cap. Although the adventurer and Maru were successful, Benatauk didn't allow her to join the adventurer further as she was still too young, but he allowed the communication via incenses. As such, she offered many clues to adventurers's missions.
